title: 5d-8: guard severity filtering
description:
## Parent

sutra/68 — 5d PRD: constraint system + DD integration

## What to build

Wire constraint severity into the guard binary's exit-code logic. Blocking violations cause non-zero exit (preventing commit). Advisory and informational violations are reported but don't block. Waived violations never block. Thin change — guard already runs the review pipeline; this adds severity filtering on constraint findings.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Blocking violations → non-zero exit
- [ ] Advisory/informational → reported, zero exit
- [ ] Waived violations → never block
- [ ] Output distinguishes severity levels
- [ ] Convention violation behavior unchanged

## Blocked by

- sutra/74 — 5d-6: review integration

acceptance_criteria.text: Guard blocks commit (non-zero exit) when blocking constraint violations exist
Advisory and informational violations reported in guard output but do not block
Waived violations do not block regardless of original severity
Guard output distinguishes blocking vs advisory vs informational findings
Existing convention violation behavior in guard unchanged
